title: Data Sciences Institute Postdoctoral Fellowship
institution: Data Sciences Institute, University of Toronto
about: The University of Toronto's Data Sciences Institute funds one-year postdoctoral fellowships in data science with a U of T or partner supervisor. Candidate proposals are due 22 January 2027 (23:59 ET); supervisor forms and reference letters by 29 January 2027.
requirements: Supervisor with a tenure or tenure-stream appointment at U of T, or an eligible PI at a funding partner institution
International applicants must complete the PhD before the start date
Supervisor form, reference letter and demographic surveys due January 29, 2027
Fellowship starts between May 1 and December 1 of the award year

upskill.name: Data Preparation & Quality I
why: field "Data science (interdisciplinary)" -> objective "Clean analytical datasets by addressing missing values, inconsistent records, duplicate information, and other common data-quality problems." (field-level fit; the stated requirements are eligibility and procedure rules)
